comparisons.peer_topic: Consumer Real Estate Loan Modification Programs
comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation offers forbearance, trial offers, and permanent modifications to consumer real estate borrowers in financial difficulty. Forbearance suspends payments and freezes aging, while permanent modifications typically extend terms (up to 30 years) and reduce interest rates, with principal forgiveness and deferrals being insignificant in 2024 and 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America describe permanent loan modification programs that offer similar concessions to financially troubled borrowers, specifically interest rate reductions and term extensions. JPMorgan notes that concessions generally include these items and that trial modification concessions are consistent with permanent ones. Bank of America details that permanent modifications typically include a term extension and an interest rate reduction, with extensions ranging from 1 to 20 years. A key difference is that Bank of America explicitly mentions the possibility of principal forgiveness and deferral in permanent modifications, whereas JPMorgan's summary highlights interest rate reductions, term extensions, and payment delays without explicitly mentioning principal forgiveness in the same context.

sentences.text: The Firm's proprietary modification programs as well as government programs, including U.S. GSE programs, generally provide various concessions to financially troubled borrowers including, but not limited to, interest rate reductions, term or payment extensions and delays of principal and/or interest payments that would otherwise have been required under the terms of the original agreement.
Concessions offered on trial modifications are generally consistent with those granted on permanent modifications.
In a permanent modification, the borrower's payment terms are typically modified in more than one manner, but generally include a term extension and an interest rate reduction.
At times, the permanent modification may also include principal forgiveness and/or a deferral of past due principal and interest amounts to the end of the loan term.
The term extensions granted for residential mortgage and home equity permanent modifications vary widely and can be up to 30 years, but most are in the range of 1 to 20 years.

comparisons.peer_topic: Residential Mortgage Subsidiary Servicing and Modification Programs
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi utilizes a third-party subservicer to assist residential mortgage borrowers in financial difficulty through interest rate reductions, forbearance, and term extensions. The process involves a three-month trial modification period before permanent modification, with $33 million and $21 million enrolled in trial programs in 2024 and 2023 respectively.
comparisons.comparison: Citigroup and JPMorgan both offer modification programs involving trial periods before permanent modifications. JPMorgan states that concessions offered on trial modifications are generally consistent with those granted on permanent modifications. Citigroup specifies a three-month trial modification period before entering into a permanent modification, where borrowers make payments under anticipated modified terms. Both banks utilize interest rate reductions and term extensions as primary concessions. Citigroup further details the use of a third-party subservicer and forbearance options, while JPMorgan references proprietary and government (U.S. GSE) programs.

sentences.text: The Firm's proprietary modification programs as well as government programs, including U.S. GSE programs, generally provide various concessions to financially troubled borrowers including, but not limited to, interest rate reductions, term or payment extensions and delays of principal and/or interest payments that would otherwise have been required under the terms of the original agreement.
Concessions offered on trial modifications are generally consistent with those granted on permanent modifications.

Through this third-party subservicer, Citi seeks to assist residential mortgage borrowers who are experiencing financial difficulty primarily by offering interest rate reductions, principal and/or interest forbearance, term extensions or combinations thereof.

In the U.S., before permanently modifying the contractual payment terms of a mortgage loan, Citi enters into a trial modification with the borrower, generally a three-month period during which the borrower makes monthly payments under the anticipated modified payment terms.
Upon successful completion of the trial period, and the borrower's formal acceptance of the modified terms, Citi and the borrower enter into a permanent modification.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm may modify terms for borrowers in financial difficulty, primarily via term extensions; modified loans were mostly performing, with negligible defaults in 2024 and ~$100 million charged off in 2023 from previously modified loans.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan both disclose that loan modifications for borrowers in financial difficulty involve concessions such as term extensions and interest rate reductions. Goldman Sachs notes that modifications in 2024 were primarily in the form of term extensions, increasing the weighted average term by 19 months. JPMorgan lists term extensions and interest rate reductions as general concessions. A distinction is that Goldman Sachs focuses heavily on the magnitude of the term extension (19 months) and the performing status of modified loans (negligible defaults), while JPMorgan focuses on the consistency of concessions between trial and permanent modifications and the inclusion of payment delays.

sentences.text: The Firm's proprietary modification programs as well as government programs, including U.S. GSE programs, generally provide various concessions to financially troubled borrowers including, but not limited to, interest rate reductions, term or payment extensions and delays of principal and/or interest payments that would otherwise have been required under the terms of the original agreement.
Such modifications may include, among other things, forbearance of interest or principal, payment extensions or interest rate reductions.

• Loan modifications during both 2024 and 2023 were primarily in the form of term extensions. These extensions increased the weighted average term by 19 months for loans modified during 2024 and by 16 months for loans modified during 2023.

comparisons.peer_topic: Loan Modification Practices for Distressed Borrowers
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm may modify loan terms for borrowers experiencing financial difficulties through mechanisms such as interest rate reductions, principal forgiveness, term extensions, and other concessions.
comparisons.comparison: Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan both identify interest rate reductions, term extensions, and other concessions as components of loan modifications for borrowers in financial difficulty. Morgan Stanley explicitly includes principal forgiveness in its list of modifications, a concession type not explicitly highlighted in JPMorgan's summary of general concessions (which lists interest rate reductions, term extensions, and payment delays). Both firms frame these modifications in the context of borrowers experiencing financial difficulties.
